summary: Akash Network is a decentralized Docker container execution and marketplace platform built on the Cosmos SDK.

key_contract_roles.Deployment: Tenant submits Deployment Specification (SDL) via MsgCreateDeployment to the blockchain.
key_contract_roles.Bid: Providers match inventory and issue automated on-chain bids via MsgCreateBid.
key_contract_roles.Lease: Tenant selects winning bid, generating an on-chain MsgCreateLease.
key_contract_roles.Provider: Remote Kubernetes orchestration agent managing decentralized workloads.

guaranteed: Secured via sequential Cosmos SDK account sequence tracking numbers preventing replay attacks across programmatic deployments.
Cosmos SDK native Secp256k1 keypair signing for ledger state transitions.
external: Transactions follow standard CometBFT mempool propagation mechanics where validators determine ordering, exposing order flow to front-running or arbitrage risks during highly congested bidding phases.

architecture.wnode_interaction: Decentralized Docker container execution on remote Provider Kubernetes clusters managed by specialized SDL (Stack Definition Language) parsing agents.

read_write_flows.writes: MsgCreateDeployment, MsgUpdateDeployment, MsgCloseDeployment, MsgCreateBid, MsgCloseBid, MsgCreateLease, DeclareProvider

architecture.enforced_determinism: Tendermint/CometBFT Delegated Proof-of-Stake (dPoS) with 75 active validators.
architecture.external_risk: Front-running risks exist on competitive marketplace bids; mitigation depends entirely on individual validator mempool processing parameters as there is no native private order flow or relay framework.

core_operation: Tenant submits Deployment Specification (SDL) via MsgCreateDeployment to the blockchain.
Providers match inventory and issue automated on-chain bids via MsgCreateBid.
Tenant selects winning bid, generating an on-chain MsgCreateLease.
Tenant authenticates with Provider via TLS mTLS using on-chain certificates to send the container workload manifest.

security_determinism.deterministic_reads_writes: On-chain state tracking secured by dPoS; multi-tenant isolation via native Kubernetes namespaces; network interactions authenticated via on-chain cryptographically matched client/provider certificates.
security_determinism.avoiding_hallucination: Protobuf message validation for MsgCreateDeployment, MsgCreateBid, and MsgCreateLease. SDL schema validation rules reject any payload not matching canonical definitions. Rejection of unauthenticated payloads via on-chain public key and provider TLS certificate validation.
security_determinism.rpc_contract_validation: Account number and sequence number verification prevents replay attacks. Deterministic signature validation uses Cosmos SDK native Secp256k1 keys. Provider endpoint validation occurs using X.509 certificates stored on-chain. Validates against RPC endpoints (e.g. rpc.akash.network) and REST endpoints (api.akash.network).

economic_model.interest_model: Standard 20% take rate for payments settled in AKT, increased to 40% when alternative settlement assets (e.g., USDC) are utilized.
economic_model.wnode_job_exposure: Total Value Locked via staked AKT token bonding natively secures the network protocol layer under Tendermint's BFT 1/3 cryptoeconomic fault tolerance limits.
economic_model.pricing_and_predictability: Utility token AKT used for governance, staking security, hosting transaction fees, and acting as the baseline unit of exchange for compute resource allocation.

deterministic_test_cases: SDL schema validation for MsgCreateDeployment payloads.
Deterministic simulation of the MsgCreateBid on-chain auction matching.
Deterministic lease settlement via MsgCreateLease transaction verification.
X.509 client certificate generation and mTLS authentication verification.
validation_strategies: Cosmos SDK Secp256k1 transaction signature validation.
SDL (Stack Definition Language) specification parsing and inventory matching.
On-chain state tracking of lease transitions via Tendermint/CometBFT.
Cryptographically matched client/provider TLS certificate validation.
example_scenarios: Deployment Creation: Tenant submits SDL via MsgCreateDeployment to the blockchain.
Automated Bidding: Providers match inventory and issue on-chain bids via MsgCreateBid.
Lease Settlement: Tenant selects winning bid and generates an on-chain MsgCreateLease.
Workload Submission: Tenant authenticates with Provider via mTLS to send the container workload manifest.
Health Check: SDK execution of akash.ping() to verify connection.
